topic_label: Objectives specified to enable risk identification

control_description: Group internal audit assesses common controls and samples division controls (P07); SOC examination each year

control_description: Controls deployed through group policies and the division supplement

control_description: Logical access infrastructure: SSO, MFA, PAM, tenant isolation

remediation: Device-bound sessions of 8 hours or less (POAM-003)

control_description: Users registered and removed through identity governance; client administrators created on signed client requests
Role-based access and least privilege

control_description: Boundary protection, WAF, and DDoS protection

control_description: Data transmission encrypted; bulk client data only through secure file exchange

control_description: EDR and container runtime protection

control_description: Configuration compliance and vulnerability scanning

control_description: Monitoring for anomalies and security events

control_description: Security events evaluated by the group SOC with division liaisons

control_description: Recovery from incidents following the P05 order
Change authorization, design, testing, and approval

remediation: Data service change gate and release testing (POAM-014, POAM-015)

control_description: Business disruption risk mitigated through the warm standby region and insurance

control_description: Vendors and partners (cloud provider A, source hosting, data aggregation partners) overseen with SOC reviews

remediation: Purge and secure exchange only (P01 FS-010)
